chunks: Would something have befallen them if they had believed in God and the Last Day, and spent of what has been given them by God? God is fully aware of all they do.
ai.seo_question: What would have happened to the hypocrites if they had believed and spent in charity?
ai.summary: In Shia exegesis, this verse is often interpreted as a rhetorical challenge to the hypocrites (Munafiqun) of Medina, suggesting that their failure was not due to lack of capacity but willful neglect of integrating faith with financial sacrifice. It underscores the principle that true belief (Iman) necessitates practical outpouring of wealth (Infaq), a concept central to the Shia understanding of the relationship between the spiritual and material realms. The mention of Allah's knowledge serves as both a warning and an assurance that their hidden hoarding and public piety are fully accounted for.
